observation.source_fact: The serious training compiler previously required an admitted JSpaceInferenceBinding but did not require the exact referenced HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v4 bytes to exist in a separate admitted receipt registry.
observation.hypothesis: A self-consistent child binding can otherwise substitute for independently admitted parent execution evidence at the dataset boundary.
observation.counterhypothesis: Child binding digest validation is sufficient because normal constructors originate from valid inference receipts.
observation.discriminator: Require an external receipt registry keyed by the binding's inference_receipt_sha256, recompute the parent receipt digest, and cross-bind every execution-critical field before any lower-level dataset compilation is reachable.

fused_requirements: registry key must equal binding inference_receipt_sha256
receipt schema/status/canonicalization must equal current HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v4 contract
receipt field set and RFC8785/JCS digest are revalidated
generation, Entry event/admission, route, engine/load, ModelExecution, GRID10, cell/role, input/model-call/output provenance are cross-bound from parent receipt to child binding
model lanes must include the bound trace role
missing parent receipt fails before lower-level dataset compilation
self-consistent child output transplant fails against the admitted parent receipt
delta.parallel_successor_integration: The retained donor advanced after this fusion and preserved the parent-receipt registry fence while adding causal-family split hardening and adjacent parent/model-input admission primitives.
